macros.name: clearflag
macros.doc: The flag at bit position ⟨position⟩ is cleared in the bit field ⟨fname⟩.

macros.name: extractflag
macros.doc: Extracts the flag setting at bit position ⟨position⟩. \extractflag expands to 1 if the flag is set and 0 otherwise.

macros.name: printflags
macros.doc: The bit field ⟨fname⟩ is converted to a decimal number.

macros.name: setflag
macros.doc: The flag at bit position ⟨position⟩ is set in the bit field ⟨fname⟩.
